items.item: The orders table starts in the first viewport; no KPI cards, hero or greeting above it
items.evidence: Audit firstTableTop=202px at 900px viewport. Above the table: breadcrumb, h1 'Đơn hàng', status tabs, filter row. No KPI cards, hero or greeting.

items.item: Page header has a plural title and exactly one primary action (create order)
items.evidence: h1 'Đơn hàng' (Vietnamese has no plural form; it is the collection title). #btnCreate 'Tạo đơn hàng' is the only filled blue button in the header. 'Nhập từ CSV' and 'Xuất Excel' are outlined. Audit headerPrimaryActions=1.

items.item: 2–3 filters are visible; applied filters show as removable chips with a clear-all control
items.evidence: Visible: search input plus three dropdown filters (#fChannel 'Kênh bán', #fRep 'Phụ trách', #fDate 'Ngày tạo'), with the rest behind '#fMore Bộ lọc khác'. renderChips() builds chips with 'Bỏ lọc ...' remove buttons and a '#clearAll Xóa tất cả' button.

items.item: Status tabs or saved views show counts
items.evidence: renderTabs(): role=tablist with 'Tất cả 126', 'Nháp 13', 'Chờ xác nhận 31', 'Đang giao 26', 'Hoàn thành 43', 'Đã hủy 8', 'Giao thất bại 5' (visible in the screenshot).

items.item: Bulk selection has a header checkbox with an indeterminate state and a bulk bar showing the selected count
items.evidence: #selAll in renderHead sets sa.indeterminate = nSel>0 && nSel<rows.length. renderBulk() shows #bulkBar with '${n} đã chọn' (tabular-nums) and the bulk actions.

items.item: When results span pages, the user can select all matching results, not just the visible page
items.evidence: renderBulk(): offerAll appears when the whole page is selected and matching.length > pageRows.length. It renders '#selMatching Chọn tất cả N đơn khớp', which sets allMatching=true. targets() then uses filtered().

items.item: Amounts are right-aligned with tabular figures and locale currency formatting; dates are absolute
items.evidence: Total cells use 'px-3 text-right tabular-nums' with Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN') (e.g. 32.053.000), unit given in the header 'Tổng tiền (VND)'. The summary uses a vi-VN VND currency formatter. Dates are absolute and tabular, e.g. '17:41 3/11/26'. Minor: the amount header sits about 20px left of the number edge because the hidden sort icon takes space, which the audit flags as numeric-align. Cell amounts also carry no ₫ symbol.

items.item: Filtering to zero results shows a no-results state with a way to clear filters, distinct from the first-use empty state
items.evidence: renderBody: `!DB.length` gives 'Chưa có đơn hàng nào' with a 'Tạo đơn hàng' CTA (first-use). `!rows.length` gives 'Không có đơn hàng nào khớp bộ lọc' or a query-specific message, plus a '#clearAll2 Xóa bộ lọc' button.

items.item: Row actions show at most two visible controls; icon-only controls have accessible names
items.evidence: Each row has a 'Sửa' text button and a kebab [data-menu] icon button (two controls). The other actions are in the menu. The kebab has aria-label 'Thao tác cho đơn ${id}', the row checkbox has aria-label 'Chọn đơn ${id}', and the header checkbox and chip-remove buttons are labelled. Audit icon-button-name has no violations.

items.item: A destructive bulk action (cancel orders) asks for confirmation naming the count and the consequence
items.evidence: runBulk('cancel') opens dialog({title:`Hủy ${n} đơn hàng?`, body: refund count + 'Thao tác này không thể hoàn tác.', confirm:`Hủy ${n} đơn`, danger:true}) with a 'Giữ nguyên' cancel button. The action is under the 'Thêm' overflow menu in red.

notes: Clean, dense, sober ERP screen: white sidebar, one blue accent, 14px type, 40px rows, radii 4-6px, no gradients, glass, emoji, KPI tiles or uppercase tracking. Status badges use semantic tones (neutral, warning, info, success, danger) that map to meaning, so I did not count them as rainbow-status. The 'HP' mark is a company logo and 'LH' is a real user, so neither is a non-person avatar. Weaknesses: a 'Trạng thái dữ liệu mẫu' demo-state select sits in the page header next to the real actions. The filter row has 3 dropdowns plus search plus 'Bộ lọc khác'. Dates render time-first with a 2-digit year ('17:41 3/11/26'). The amount column header is slightly offset from the right-aligned numbers (audit numeric-align error, score 90).
